name: Sour Mango - Your all-in-one travel companion
tagline: Sour Mango is a comprehensive mobile application designed specifically for digital nomads and long-term travelers
description: Sour Mango is a comprehensive mobile application designed specifically for digital nomads and long-term travelers. It consolidates essential travel tools into a single platform, allowing users to plan trips in seconds rather than hours. The app serves as a personal travel assistant that helps you navigate new cities with confidence and ease. Smart Planning and Local Insights The platform features an AI trip planner and a dedicated travel assistant available to answer questions about destinations
